tools.label: Typographic arrows:
n.dropwrong1: And what exactly is that supposed to do?
n.typo_done: Yes, yes, you already found that one. Stop rubbing it in.
h.none: No ideas right now. Odd: I usually have too many.
card.ch15.label: Chapter 15
card.ch15.title: The Last Page
end.ch15.title: The End
end.ch15.body:
Thank you for reading the manual. Really: you read all of it.
GRAND ADVENTURE DELUXE was never released. This manual was.
rule.l1: As long as there are errors, there is {}.
rule.l2: The Hero, in the end, says: {}.
page.p43.title: The last page
page.p43.intro: Three lines, written together. Each in our own colour.
page.p43.page: Fig. 43 — The last page, ready for printing
page.p43.margin: every line is a chapter we lived through
page.p44.title: Our words
page.p44.intro: Words saved during the game. Some we need. Others tempt us.
page.p44.margin: perfect isn't one of our words
art.lp.title: THE LAST PAEG
art.cr.title: END CREDITS
art.cr.body:
The Narrator — as himself
The Pencil — author of the errors
The Proofreader — red pen, kind
The Hero — assembled back to front
The designer — who was there
The reader — you, who read the manual
n.i1: Here we are. The last page of the manual. Blank. Enormous.
c.i1: Three lines. Not one more, not one less. That's my only condition.
p.i1: and we write them with our words. the ones we saved.
n.i2: We're all here. Me too, in the world, for once. I'm rounder than I thought.
n.i3: Page 43: the three lines. Page 44: our words. Choose well. It's forever.
n.empty1: The back of the book. After this page there's only the cover.
n.credits_empty: Read the credits. They're a page of the manual. Obviously.
n.tool1: No arrows on the last page. Only words.
n.typo_last: "The last paeg". Even the last page has a typo. It couldn't be otherwise.
n.typo_tray: "Printing trai". The Proofreader pretends not to see it. He really has changed.
n.tray: The printing tray. When the page is ready, it goes here.
n.self1: Yes, that's me. In the world. With the top hat. Don't stare.
n.self2: I've been an illustration, lost my voice, found it again. A complete character arc.
p.tap1: the first line is my sentence. remember where we saved it?
p.tap2: after this page there are no more errors to make. i'm a bit sad about that.
c.tap1: Three lines. Then I'll only correct commas. I promise.
c.tap2: She would have wanted an ending like this. Imperfect.
n.page: The blank page. The lines are filled in from the manual, page 43.
n.page_ready: Three lines, written and signed. The printing tray is waiting.
c.perfect: PERFECT? No. Nobody reads a perfect ending. A pencil taught me that.
n.options: "Options"... no. In the end he says the other word. The one he learned by himself.
n.end_word: THE END goes at the end, not in the middle. Every self-respecting manual says so.
p.more: a few lines are still missing.
n.ready1: Three lines. "As long as there are errors, there is hope". "Forward". "Eight metres".
c.ready: Approved. Without a single correction. That has never happened to me.
p.ready: let's all sign and take it to print. the page is on page 43.
c.print1: Final edition. With errata. And a last page written by four hands. And a head on backwards.
n.cr1: The credits. They're... a page of the manual. The Hero wants to read them.
n.cr2: NARRATOR. The Narrator. Fine, fine. Go on.
c.cr1: Pencil. But let him be. He's learning.
p.cr1: perfect. a typo in his name at last.
n.cr3: ...The end. Thank you for reading the manual. Really, did you read it?
h.lines.1: The three lines are on page 43; the saved words on page 44.
h.lines.2: A sentence saved by tearing out a page, the Hero's new word, the length of the bridge.
h.lines.3: HOPE on the first line, FORWARD on the second, 8 METRES on the third.
h.print.1: The last page is ready. It needs printing.
h.print.2: At the bottom right there's the printing tray.
h.print.3: Drag the last page (page 43) onto the printing tray.
